definitions.explanation: A sport in which players use clubs to hit a ball into a series of holes on a course.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{週末|しゅうまつ}にゴルフをする。
examples.english: My father plays golf on weekends.

examples.japanese: ゴルフは{接待|せったい}でよく{使|つか}われる。
examples.english: Golf is often used for business entertainment.

examples.japanese: ゴルフ{場|じょう}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I made a reservation at a golf course.

notes:
Golf is popular in Japan, especially among business professionals. It is often used for {接待|せったい}ゴルフ (business entertainment golf).

Common expressions:
- ゴルフをする (to play golf)
- ゴルフ{場|じょう} (golf course)
- ゴルフクラブ (golf club)
- {打|う}ちっ{放|ぱな}し (driving range)
